name: DIVIJ SHARAN
bio:
Career Overview: Divij Sharan is an Indian professional tennis player specializing in doubles, known for his strong volleying and teamwork on the court.
Playing Style: A crafty doubles player with excellent net skills, favoring grass and hard courts, and a reliable volley as his signature shot.
Career-High ATP Singles Ranking: #438 (August 13, 2007), Career-High ATP Doubles Ranking: #36 (July 16, 2018).
Best Grand Slam Singles Performance: Limited success in singles, primarily competed in lower-tier events.
Grand Slam Achievements: Reached the third round in men’s doubles at Wimbledon (2018) and the US Open (2017).
Notable Achievements: Olympic Participation: Represented India at the 2020 Tokyo Olympics in men’s doubles. ATP Titles: Secured 5 ATP doubles titles, including the 2019 St. Petersburg Open with Igor Zelenay. Davis Cup & National Representation: Played for India in the Davis Cup since 2012, contributing to key victories. Asian Games: Won a gold medal in men’s doubles at the 2018 Asian Games with Rohan Bopanna and a bronze in 2014 with Yuki Bhambri.
Other Highlights: Married British tennis player Samantha Murray in 2019. Recognized with the Arjuna Award for his contributions to Indian tennis. Sharan continues to compete actively on the ATP Tour, cementing his status as a dependable doubles specialist. 🎾🇮🇳
